                          const HighlightStyle& s,int start,int end,int frames,float fontSize,unsigned seed) {
        validateStyle(s);
        if (!std::isfinite(fontSize) || fontSize<=0 || start<0 || end>=frames)
            throw std::invalid_argument("highlight timing or font size invalid");
        const float width=s.widthEm>0?s.widthEm*fontSize:s.width;
        auto layer=Paths::strokeLayer(id,Paths::polyline(points),start,end,frames,s.color,width);
        layer["opacity"]=s.opacity;
        auto& stroke=layer["shape"]["stroke"];
        stroke["cap"]="butt";
        if (s.dashed) stroke["dash_array"]={8,5};
        if (s.rough) stroke["brush"]={{"size",width},{"width_jitter",.12f},
            {"edge_noise",.12f},{"grain",.1f},{"seed",seed},
            {"texture",{{"generator","perlin"},{"seed",seed},{"frequency",4.f}}}};
        if (s.glow) layer["effects"]=Json::array({{{"type","bloom"},{"threshold",.2f},
            {"radius",12.f},{"intensity",.8f}}});
        return layer;
    }

    float easeInOut(float p) {

        return p*p*(3.f-2.f*p);

    Paths::Point samplePolyline(const std::vector<Paths::Point>& pts,float u) {
        if (pts.size()<2) throw std::invalid_argument("polyline needs 2+ points");
        u=std::clamp(u,0.f,1.f);
        std::vector<double> cum{0.0};
        double total=0.0;
        for (std::size_t i=1;i<pts.size();++i) {
            const double dx=pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0], dy=pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1];
            total+=std::hypot(dx,dy);
            cum.push_back(total);
        }
        if (total<=1.e-9) return pts.front();
        const double target=static_cast<double>(u)*total;
        for (std::size_t i=1;i<pts.size();++i) {
            if (target<=cum[i]) {
                const double seg=cum[i]-cum[i-1];
                const double f=seg>1.e-12?(target-cum[i-1])/seg:0.0;
                return {static_cast<float>(pts[i-1][0]+(pts[i][0]-pts[i-1][0])*f),
                        static_cast<float>(pts[i-1][1]+(pts[i][1]-pts[i-1][1])*f)};
            }
        }
        return pts.back();
    }

    J rect(std::string id, double x, double y, double w, double h,

    // ChrononTemplate — Modern Documentary pack.
    //
    // Five native RenderPlan V3 looks distilled from the supplied modern
    // documentary references:
    //
    //   VoxHighlight   paper article, left-anchored multiply highlighter, subject
    //                  cutout, rack focus and floating dust.
    //   SplitGlitch    torn split composition, glowing energy divider, UI card in
    //                  Z-space with chromatic/mesh/slice glitch treatment.
    //   MacroUiRain    macro comment UI, typewriter sentence, layered crowd
    //                  silhouettes and a banknote particle rain with HUD.
    //   KineticType    four 3D typographic beats, left-to-right bars and a
    //                  whip-pan camera with a 180-degree temporal shutter.
    //   VhsCarousel    CRT frame, spring-overshoot logo carousel, hot title and
    //                  analog scanline/chroma wear.
    //
    // Every look is authored as ordinary `chronon.render-plan.v3` data. Chronon3D
    // owns rasterization, effects, camera sampling and encoding; this module owns
    // the design vocabulary and timing. No browser, DOM or live JS is involved.
    //
    // The pack deliberately uses the renderer's existing primitives:
    //   * multiply blend + shape scale/position tracks (highlighter),
    //   * camera_samples with thin-lens DoF (rack focus),
    //   * text_animators + a character selector (typewriter),
    //   * temporal_motion_blur + per-frame camera_samples (whip pan),
    //   * chromatic_aberration, mesh_warp, scanlines, retro_tv, roughen_edges,
    //     lens_distortion, glow/bloom and directional_blur (analog/UI wear),
    //   * particle_emitter sprite, rotation and angular_velocity fields.
    //
    // The banknote rain is a 2.5D environment emitter: it uses the existing
    // per-particle sprite rotation and fake depth/DoF fields. It is not a claim of
    // a full six-degree-of-freedom rigid-body particle solver.

    Json text(const std::string& id, const std::string& value, float left, float top,

              float z, Json animation = Json::array(), Json animators = Json::array(),
              float opacity = 1.f, const std::string& blend = "normal") {
        const float content = std::max(10.f, measuredTextWidth(value, size, font));
        const float width = content * 1.15f;
        const float height = size * 1.6f;
        Json layer = {{"id", id}, {"type", "text"}, {"text", value},
                      {"size", Json::array({width, height})},
                      {"position", Json::array({left + content * 0.5f,
                                                wireY(top + height * 0.5f), z})},
                      {"enable_3d", true},
                      {"style", {{"font", font}, {"font_size", size}, {"fill", color}}},
                      {"start_frame", 0}, {"duration_frames", duration}};
        if (!animation.empty()) layer["animation"] = Json{{"tracks", std::move(animation)}};
        if (!animators.empty()) layer["text_animators"] = std::move(animators);
        if (opacity != 1.f) layer["opacity"] = opacity;
        if (blend != "normal") layer["blend_mode"] = blend;
        return layer;
    }

    Json typewriter(const std::string& id, int duration, int begin, int span) {
        const int done = std::min(duration - 1, begin + span);
        Json selector = {{"id", id + "_selector"}, {"unit", "grapheme"},
                         {"shape", "square"}, {"order", "forward"},
                         {"combine", "replace"}, {"exclude_spaces", true},
                         {"start", {{"easing", "linear"},
                                    {"keyframes", Json::array({
                                        key(0, 0.0), key(begin, 0.0), key(done, 100.0),
                                        key(duration - 1, 100.0)})}}},
                         {"end", {{"easing", "linear"},
                                  {"keyframes", Json::array({
                                      key(0, 100.0), key(duration - 1, 100.0)})}}}};
        Json opacity = track("opacity", Json::array({key(0, 0.0), key(duration - 1, 0.0)}));
        return Json{{"id", id + "_typewriter"}, {"selectors", Json::array({selector})},
                    {"properties", Json::array({opacity})}};
    }

    [[noreturn]] void fail(const std::string& message) {

    Json rgba(const std::string& hex, float alpha = 1.f) {
        if (hex.size() != 7 || hex.front() != '#')
            throw std::invalid_argument("ModernDocumentaryPack: color must be #RRGGBB");
        const unsigned value = static_cast<unsigned>(std::stoul(hex.substr(1), nullptr, 16));
        return Json::array({((value >> 16) & 255U) / 255.0, ((value >> 8) & 255U) / 255.0,
                            (value & 255U) / 255.0, static_cast<double>(alpha)});
    }
    
    float wireY(float topDownY) { return static_cast<float>(kH) - topDownY; }
    
    Json key(int frame, double value) {
        return Json{{"frame", frame}, {"value", value}};
    }
    
    Json track(const std::string& property, Json keys, const std::string& easing = "linear") {
        return Json{{"property", property}, {"easing", easing}, {"keyframes", std::move(keys)}};
    }
    
    /// Left-to-right marker reveal. scale_x and position_x are coupled so the
    /// authored left edge stays pinned while the right edge travels.
    Json sweepTracks(float width, int begin, int span) {
        Json scaleKeys = Json::array();
        Json positionKeys = Json::array();
        scaleKeys.push_back(key(0, 0.0));
        scaleKeys.push_back(key(begin, 0.0));
        scaleKeys.push_back(key(begin + span, 1.0));
        scaleKeys.push_back(key(begin + span + 1, 1.0));
        positionKeys.push_back(key(0, -width * 0.5));
        positionKeys.push_back(key(begin, -width * 0.5));
        positionKeys.push_back(key(begin + span, 0.0));
        positionKeys.push_back(key(begin + span + 1, 0.0));
        return Json::array({
            track("opacity", Json::array({key(0, 0.0), key(begin, 0.0),
                                          key(begin + 1, 1.0), key(begin + span + 1, 1.0)})),
            track("scale_x", std::move(scaleKeys), "in_out_cubic"),
            track("position_x", std::move(positionKeys), "in_out_cubic")});
    }
    
    Json effectNoise(float amount, unsigned seed, float size = 1.f, bool animated = true) {
        return Json{{"type", "noise"}, {"amount", amount}, {"seed", seed}, {"size", size},
                    {"animated", animated}};
    }

    Json highlightRegionLayers(const std::string& id,const HighlightRegion& r,
                                const std::string& preset,const HighlightTiming& t) {
        validateRegion(r);
        auto style=highlightingStyle(preset);
        Json layers=Json::array();
        std::vector<Paths::Point> points;
        const bool marker=preset.rfind("marker",0)==0 || preset=="archive_yellow" || preset=="phrase_highlight";
        const bool underline=preset.rfind("underline",0)==0;
        if (marker || underline) {
            style.widthEm=0;
            style.width=marker?r.height*.8f:std::max(1.f,r.height*.06f);
            for (unsigned i=0;i<=64;++i) {
                const float u=i/64.f;
                const float wave=preset=="underline_wave"?std::sin(u*18.849556f)*r.height*.08f:0.f;
                points.push_back({r.x+r.width*u,r.y+(marker?r.height*.5f:r.height+style.width)+wave});
            }
        } else if (preset=="investigation_circle") {
            for (unsigned i=0;i<=96;++i) {
                const float a=i*6.2831853f/96.f;
                points.push_back({r.x+r.width*.5f+r.width*.55f*std::cos(a),
                                  r.y+r.height*.5f+r.height*.65f*std::sin(a)});
            }
        } else {
            points={{r.x,r.y},{r.x+r.width,r.y},{r.x+r.width,r.y+r.height},
                    {r.x,r.y+r.height},{r.x,r.y}};
        }
        auto stroke=highlightStroke(id,points,style,t.start,t.revealEnd,t.frames,56,t.seed);
        if (preset=="box_pulse" || preset=="data_emphasis")
            stroke["animation"]={{"tracks",Json::array({Motion::track("opacity",{
                {0,.25f},{t.frames/3,1.f},{2*t.frames/3,.45f},{t.frames-1,1.f}},"in_out_sine")})}};
        if (preset=="focus_dim" || preset=="focus_vignette") {
            layers=focusDim(r,preset=="focus_dim"?.65f:.4f,t.frames);
        }
        if (preset=="focus_zoom")
            stroke["animation"]={{"tracks",Json::array({Motion::track("scale",{
                {0,1.f},{t.frames-1,1.08f}},"in_out_sine")})}};
        layers.push_back(stroke);
        if (preset=="marker_double") {
            for (auto& point:points) point[1]+=style.width*.25f;
            style.width*=.6f;style.opacity*=.6f;
            layers.push_back(highlightStroke(id+"_second",points,style,t.start,t.revealEnd,t.frames,56,t.seed+1));
        }
        return layers;
    }

            {"masks",Json::array({{{"type","path"},{"mode","subtract"},{"path",path},{"feather",feather}}})}};
    }

    HighlightStyle highlightingStyle(const std::string& preset) {
        const auto presets=highlightingPresets();
        if (std::find(presets.begin(),presets.end(),preset)==presets.end())
            throw std::invalid_argument("unknown highlighting preset");
        HighlightStyle s;
        s.rough=preset=="marker_rough" || preset=="underline_scribble" || preset=="marker_ink";
        s.glow=preset=="underline_glow";
        s.dashed=preset=="box_scan" || preset=="document_scan";
        if (preset.rfind("underline",0)==0) {s.opacity=1.f;s.widthEm=.06f;}
        if (preset=="evidence_red" || preset=="investigation_circle") {s.color="#E03B2F";s.opacity=.9f;}
        if (preset.rfind("callout",0)==0 || preset.rfind("box",0)==0) {s.color="#72CFFF";s.opacity=.9f;}
        return s;
    }

    // ChrononTemplate — misura reale delle larghezze testo (stb_truetype).
    //
    // textLayer dimensionava i box con una stima euristica: il renderer centra
    // la run nel box, quindi un box sovrastimato sposta il testo a destra e
    // scolla marker/highlight dalla frase. Qui misuriamo gli advance reali dal
    // font indicato nello style (stessi file OTF/TTF usati dal renderer), con
    // fallback alla stima se il font non si carica.
    #ifndef CHRONONTEMPLATE_WEB_FONT_MEASURE_HPP
    #define CHRONONTEMPLATE_WEB_FONT_MEASURE_HPP
    
    #include <string>
    
    namespace chronontemplate::web::shot {
    
    // Larghezza in px di `text` a `sizePx`, misurata con gli advance del font.
    // `fontRef` e' il riferimento usato nei plan (es.
    // "ChrononTemplate/assets/fonts/HelveticaNeue-Bold.otf", relativo alla root
    // del workspace). Ritorna un valore <= 0 se la misura fallisce (il chiamante
    // usa measuredTextWidth come fallback).
    [[nodiscard]] float measureTextWidth(const std::string& fontRef, float sizePx,
                                         const std::string& text);
    
    // Tabella deterministica usata SOLO quando il font non si carica. E' l'unica
    // copia nel template: i pack web non devono reimplementarla.
    [[nodiscard]] float estimateTextWidth(const std::string& text, float sizePx);
    
    // Autorita' unica di misura per i preset editoriali: advance shaped dal font

    [[nodiscard]] float measuredTextWidth(const std::string& text, float sizePx,

    } // namespace chronontemplate::web::shot

    Json TemplateComposition::renderPlan(const std::string& jobId, int width, int height, int fps,
                                         int durationFrames, const Json& layers, const Json& camera,
                                         const Json& cameraSamples, const Json& output) {
        requireId(jobId);
        if (width<=0 || height<=0 || fps<=0 || durationFrames<=0 || !layers.is_array())
            throw std::invalid_argument("composition canvas/layers are invalid");
        std::set<std::string> ids;
        for (const Json& layer : layers) {
            if (!layer.is_object() || !layer.contains("id")) throw std::invalid_argument("each layer needs an id");
            if (!ids.insert(layer.at("id").get<std::string>()).second) throw std::invalid_argument("layer ids must be unique");
            if (layer.contains("animation")) {
                const Json& animation = layer.at("animation");
                if (!animation.is_object() || !animation.contains("tracks") ||
                    !animation.at("tracks").is_array())
                    throw std::invalid_argument("layer animation must contain a tracks array");
                std::set<std::string> properties;
                for (const Json& track : animation.at("tracks")) {
                    if (!track.is_object() || !track.contains("property") ||
                        !track.at("property").is_string())
                        throw std::invalid_argument("animation tracks need a property name");
                    if (!properties.insert(track.at("property").get<std::string>()).second)
                        throw std::invalid_argument("layer animation properties must be unique");
                }
            }
        }
        if (!cameraSamples.is_null() && (!cameraSamples.is_array() || cameraSamples.empty() || camera.is_null()))
            throw std::invalid_argument("camera_samples require a non-empty array and a base camera");
        Json plan={{"schema","chronon.render-plan.v3"},{"version",3},{"job_id",jobId},
            {"canvas",{{"width",width},{"height",height},{"fps_num",fps},{"fps_den",1},{"duration_frames",durationFrames}}},
            {"layers",layers},{"output",output.is_null()?Json{{"path",jobId+".mp4"},{"format","mp4"},{"codec","h264"}}:output}};
        if (!camera.is_null()) plan["camera"]=camera;
        if (!cameraSamples.is_null()) plan["camera_samples"]=cameraSamples;
        return plan;
    }

    // ChrononTemplate — implementazione misura testo.
    //
    // Primaria: HarfBuzz (stesso shaper del renderer: advance con GPOS/kerning,
    // entro ~1% dalle run renderizzate su Helvetica/Playfair/Arial). Fallback:
    // stb_truetype senza shaping (sottostima del 10-30% su alcuni font), poi

    fs::path resolveFont(const std::string& ref) {
        const fs::path p(ref);
        if (fs::exists(p)) return p;
        // L'emitter gira dentro ChrononTemplate/, il ref e' relativo al workspace.
        const fs::path up = fs::path("..") / p;
        if (fs::exists(up)) return up;
        return {};
    }
    
    std::vector<unsigned char> loadBytes(const fs::path& path) {
        std::ifstream f(path, std::ios::binary | std::ios::ate);
        if (!f) return {};
        const auto bytes = static_cast<std::size_t>(f.tellg());
        f.seekg(0);
        std::vector<unsigned char> data(bytes);
        if (!f.read(reinterpret_cast<char*>(data.data()), static_cast<std::streamsize>(bytes)))
            return {};
        return data;
    }
    
    #ifdef CHRONONTEMPLATE_HAVE_HARFBUZZ
    
    float measureHB(const std::vector<unsigned char>& data, float sizePx, const std::string& text) {
        hb_blob_t* blob = hb_blob_create(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(data.data()),
                                         static_cast<unsigned>(data.size()), HB_MEMORY_MODE_READONLY,
                                         nullptr, nullptr);
        hb_face_t* face = hb_face_create(blob, 0);
        hb_blob_destroy(blob);
        if (hb_face_get_upem(face) == 0) { hb_face_destroy(face); return -1.f; }
        hb_font_t* font = hb_font_create(face);
        hb_face_destroy(face);
        hb_ot_font_set_funcs(font);
        const int scaled = static_cast<int>(std::lround(sizePx * 64.0));
        hb_font_set_scale(font, scaled, scaled);
        hb_buffer_t* buf = hb_buffer_create();
        hb_buffer_add_utf8(buf, text.data(), static_cast<int>(text.size()), 0,
                           static_cast<int>(text.size()));
        hb_buffer_guess_segment_properties(buf);
        hb_shape(font, buf, nullptr, 0);
        unsigned count = 0;
        hb_glyph_position_t* pos = hb_buffer_get_glyph_positions(buf, &count);
        double width = 0.0;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; ++i) width += pos[i].x_advance / 64.0;
        hb_buffer_destroy(buf);
        hb_font_destroy(font);
        return static_cast<float>(width);
    }

    // Decodifica UTF-8 minima per il fallback senza shaping.
    std::uint32_t nextCodepoint(const char*& p, const char* end) {
        if (p >= end) return 0;
        auto c = static_cast<unsigned char>(*p);
        if (c < 0x80) { ++p; return c; }
        std::uint32_t cp = 0; int extra = 0;
        if ((c & 0xE0) == 0xC0) { cp = c & 0x1F; extra = 1; }
        else if ((c & 0xF0) == 0xE0) { cp = c & 0x0F; extra = 2; }
        else if ((c & 0xF8) == 0xF0) { cp = c & 0x07; extra = 3; }
        else { ++p; return 0xFFFD; }
        ++p;
        for (int i = 0; i < extra && p < end; ++i, ++p) {
            auto cc = static_cast<unsigned char>(*p);
            if ((cc & 0xC0) != 0x80) return 0xFFFD;
            cp = (cp << 6) | (cc & 0x3F);
        }
        return cp;
    }

    using Json = nlohmann::json;
    using Point = native::Paths::Point;
    constexpr int kW = 1920, kH = 1080, kFps = 30;
    constexpr const char* kInter = "ChrononTemplate/assets/fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf";
    constexpr const char* kInterBold = "ChrononTemplate/assets/fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf";
    constexpr const char* kSerif = "ChrononTemplate/assets/fonts/PlayfairDisplay.ttf";
    
    struct BodyLine { std::string text; std::size_t begin{}, end{}; float y{}; };
    
    Json color(const std::string& hex, float alpha = 1.f) {
        if (hex.size() != 7 || hex.front() != '#') throw std::invalid_argument("color must be #RRGGBB");
        const auto v = std::stoul(hex.substr(1), nullptr, 16);
        return Json::array({((v >> 16) & 255) / 255.0, ((v >> 8) & 255) / 255.0,
                            (v & 255) / 255.0, alpha});
    }
    
    Json rect(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h,
              const std::string& fill, float alpha, int frames, bool screen = false) {
        Json layer{{"id", id}, {"type", "shape"}, {"enable_3d", !screen},
                   {"size", {w, h}}, {"position", {x + w * .5f - 960.f, 540.f - (y + h * .5f), 0.f}},
                   {"start_frame", 0}, {"duration_frames", frames},
                   {"shape", {{"type", "rect"}, {"fill", color(fill, alpha)}}}};
        if (screen) { layer["screen_space"] = true; layer["position"] = {0.f, 0.f}; }
        return layer;
    }
    
    Json textLayer(const std::string& id, const std::string& text, float x, float y,
                   float size, const char* font, const std::string& fill, int frames) {
        Json layer = chronontemplate::web::shot::textLayer(id, text, x, y, size, font, fill, frames);
        const float run = shot::measuredTextWidth(text, size, font);
        layer["position"][0] = x + run * .5f - 960.f;
        layer["position"][1] = 540.f - y - layer["size"][1].get<float>() * .5f;
        return layer;
    }
    
    float measure(const std::string& text, float size, const char* font) {
        return std::max(0.f, shot::measuredTextWidth(text, size, font));
    }
    
    std::vector<BodyLine> wrapBody(const std::string& body, float size, const char* font,
                                   float maxWidth, float firstY) {
        std::vector<BodyLine> lines;
        std::size_t para = 0;
        float y = firstY;
        while (para <= body.size()) {
            const std::size_t nl = body.find('\n', para);
            const std::size_t paraEnd = nl == std::string::npos ? body.size() : nl;
            std::size_t start = para;
            while (start < paraEnd) {
                while (start < paraEnd && body[start] == ' ') ++start;
                std::size_t end = start;
                std::size_t lastFit = start;
                while (end < paraEnd) {
                    const std::size_t space = body.find(' ', end);
                    const std::size_t wordEnd = std::min(space == std::string::npos ? paraEnd : space, paraEnd);
                    const std::string candidate = body.substr(start, wordEnd - start);
                    if (measure(candidate, size, font) > maxWidth && lastFit > start) break;
                    if (measure(candidate, size, font) > maxWidth) { lastFit = wordEnd; break; }
                    lastFit = wordEnd;
                    end = wordEnd;
                    if (end >= paraEnd) break;
                    end = body.find_first_not_of(' ', end);
                    if (end == std::string::npos || end >= paraEnd) break;
                }
                if (lastFit <= start) lastFit = paraEnd;
                const std::size_t visibleEnd = lastFit;
                if (visibleEnd > start) {
                    lines.push_back({body.substr(start, visibleEnd - start), start, visibleEnd, y});
                    y += size * 1.42f;
                }
                start = visibleEnd;
                while (start < paraEnd && body[start] == ' ') ++start;
            }
            if (nl == std::string::npos) break;
            para = nl + 1;
            if (para < body.size() && body[para] == '\n') { y += size * .78f; ++para; }
        }
        return lines;
    }
    
    Json roughMarker(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height,
                     const std::string& hex, float opacity, bool rough,
                     int start, int reveal, int frames, unsigned seed) {
        std::vector<Point> points;
        const int segments = std::max(4, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(width / 34.f)));
        for (int i = 0; i <= segments; ++i) {
            const float u = static_cast<float>(i) / segments;
            const float wobble = (i == 0 || i == segments) ? 0.f : std::sin(i * 2.1f + seed) * height * .028f;
            points.push_back({x + width * u, y + wobble});
        }
        native::HighlightStyle style;
        style.color = hex;
        style.opacity = opacity;
        style.width = height;
        style.rough = rough;
        Json layer = native::highlightStroke(id, points, style, start, start + reveal,
                                             frames, height, seed);
        layer["blend_mode"] = "multiply";
        return layer;
    }
    
    Json effectStack(const DocumentEvidenceSpec& spec, unsigned seed) {
        Json effects = Json::array({
            Json{{"type", "noise"}, {"amount", spec.grain}, {"seed", seed}, {"size", 1.f}, {"animated", false}},
            Json{{"type", "chromatic_aberration"}, {"red_offset", .8f}, {"blue_offset", -.8f}},
            Json{{"type", "vignette"}, {"amount", spec.vignette}, {"radius", .58f}, {"softness", .72f}}});
        if (spec.scanlines) effects.push_back(Json{{"type", "scanlines"}, {"spacing_px", 2.5f},
                                                   {"amount", .025f}, {"phase", 0.f}});
        return effects;
    }
    
    Json cameraPlan(const DocumentEvidenceSpec& spec, bool macro) {
        const float cameraZ = macro ? 1700.f : 1320.f;
        chrononmotion::motion::CameraRig rig(1, spec.fovDegrees, float(kW) / kH, 1.f, 10000.f);
        rig.setPosition({0.f, 0.f, cameraZ});
        const float push = std::clamp(spec.cameraPush, 0.f, .2f) * cameraZ;
        if (push > 0.f) chrononmotion::motion::presets::cameraPush(rig, 0, spec.durationFrames - 1,
                                                                   push, float(spec.fps));
        Json samples = native::Camera::samples(rig, float(spec.fps), spec.durationFrames);
        const Json rotation = macro ? Json::array({spec.tiltXDegrees, spec.tiltYDegrees, spec.rollDegrees})
                                    : Json::array({0.f, 0.f, 0.f});
        const float focus = cameraZ - (macro ? push * .5f : 0.f);
        for (Json& sample : samples) {
            sample["camera"]["rotation_deg"] = rotation;
            sample["camera"]["dof"] = {{"enabled", spec.depthOfField}, {"focus_distance", focus},
                                         {"max_blur", 18.f}, {"highlight_gain", .2f}};
            if (spec.depthOfField) sample["camera"]["f_stop"] = 2.5f;
        }
        return Json{{"camera", samples.front().at("camera")}, {"camera_samples", std::move(samples)}};
    }
    
    } // namespace
    
    void DocumentEvidenceSpec::validate() const {
        if (fps != kFps) throw std::invalid_argument("DocumentEvidencePack fps must be 30");
        if (durationFrames < 30 || durationFrames > 300) throw std::invalid_argument("durationFrames must be in [30,300]");
        if (title.empty() && body.empty() && sourceImage.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("document content is empty");
        if (grain < 0.f || grain > .1f || vignette < 0.f || vignette > 1.f || cameraPush < 0.f || cameraPush > .2f)
            throw std::invalid_argument("document optical settings are out of range");
        for (const auto& h : highlights) {
            if (h.byteStart >= h.byteEnd || h.byteEnd > body.size() || h.startFrame < 0 ||
                h.revealFrames < 1 || h.startFrame + h.revealFrames >= durationFrames ||
                h.opacity < 0.f || h.opacity > 1.f)
                throw std::invalid_argument("document highlight range or timing is invalid");
        }
    }
    
    std::string DocumentEvidenceSpec::planName() const {
        return recipe == DocumentEvidenceRecipe::CinematicMacro
            ? "document_evidence_cinematic_macro_v1" : "document_evidence_marker_highlight_v1";
    }
    
    nlohmann::json buildDocumentEvidencePlan(const DocumentEvidenceSpec& spec) {
        spec.validate();
        const bool macro = spec.recipe == DocumentEvidenceRecipe::CinematicMacro;
        const float textSize = macro ? 31.f : 31.f;
        const char* bodyFont = macro ? kSerif : kInter;
        const float left = macro ? 230.f : 260.f;
        const float maxWidth = macro ? 1420.f : 1400.f;
        const float bodyY = spec.title.empty() ? 325.f : 392.f;
        const float pageX = macro ? 90.f : 0.f;
        const float pageY = macro ? 70.f : 0.f;
        const float pageW = macro ? 1740.f : float(kW);
        const float pageH = macro ? 940.f : float(kH);
        Json layers = Json::array();
    
        Json desk = rect("document_desk", 0.f, 0.f, float(kW), float(kH), "#111315", 1.f,
                         spec.durationFrames, true);
        desk["effects"] = effectStack(spec, 731);
        layers.push_back(std::move(desk));
        Json paper = rect("document_paper", pageX, pageY, pageW, pageH,
                          macro ? "#E9E8E6" : "#E6E3E1", 1.f, spec.durationFrames, !macro);
        paper["effects"] = Json::array({Json{{"type", "noise"}, {"amount", spec.grain},
                                             {"seed", 2203}, {"size", 1.f}, {"animated", false}}});
        if (!macro) paper["effects"].push_back(Json{{"type", "vignette"}, {"amount", spec.vignette},
                                                    {"radius", .58f}, {"softness", .72f}});
        layers.push_back(std::move(paper));
    
        if (!spec.sourceImage.empty()) {
            layers.push_back(shot::image("document_source", spec.sourceImage, pageX, pageY, pageW, pageH,
                                         spec.durationFrames));
        }
    
        const auto lines = wrapBody(spec.body, textSize, bodyFont, maxWidth, bodyY);
        if (!macro) {
            for (const DocumentHighlight& h : spec.highlights) {
                for (std::size_t n = 0; n < lines.size(); ++n) {
                    const BodyLine& line = lines[n];
                    const std::size_t begin = std::max(h.byteStart, line.begin);
                    const std::size_t end = std::min(h.byteEnd, line.end);
                    if (begin >= end) continue;
                    const float prefix = measure(line.text.substr(0, begin - line.begin), textSize, bodyFont);
                    const float width = measure(line.text.substr(begin - line.begin, end - begin), textSize, bodyFont);
                    layers.push_back(roughMarker("marker_" + std::to_string(n) + "_" + std::to_string(h.startFrame),
                        left + prefix, line.y + textSize * .65f, width + 5.f, textSize * 1.06f,
                        h.color, h.opacity, h.rough, h.startFrame + static_cast<int>(n) * 8,
                        h.revealFrames, spec.durationFrames, 731U + static_cast<unsigned>(n)));
                }
            }
        }
    
        if (!spec.title.empty()) {
            Json title = textLayer("document_title", spec.title, left, 320.f, 40.f, kInterBold,
                                   "#353535", spec.durationFrames);
            if (macro) title["effects"] = Json::array({Json{{"type", "gaussian_blur"}, {"radius", 1.4f}}});
            layers.push_back(std::move(title));
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i)
            layers.push_back(textLayer("document_body_" + std::to_string(i), lines[i].text,
                                       left, lines[i].y, textSize, bodyFont, "#353535", spec.durationFrames));
    
        Json camera = cameraPlan(spec, macro);
        Json plan = native::TemplateComposition::renderPlan(spec.planName(), kW, kH, spec.fps,
            spec.durationFrames, layers, camera["camera"], camera["camera_samples"],
            {{"path", spec.planName() + ".mp4"}, {"format", "mp4"}, {"codec", "h264"}});
        plan["lighting_rig"] = {{"key_direction", {0.f, 0.f, 1.f}}, {"key_intensity", 0.f},
                                {"key_color", {1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f}}, {"ambient_intensity", 1.f},
                                {"ambient_color", {1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f}}, {"rim_enabled", false}};
        return plan;
    }

        auto green = rect("highlight_green", x - 4.f, greenY, greenW, 39.f,
                          "#C9DC28", 1.f, sweepTracks(greenW, 22, 24), d);
        layers.push_back(green);
    
        const float prefix = measuredTextWidth("the real thing. But ", body, kSerif);
        const float yellowW = measuredTextWidth("when those pills actually contain fentanyl,", body, kSerif) + 10.f;
        auto yellow = rect("highlight_yellow", x + prefix - 4.f, y2 - 5.f, yellowW, 39.f,
                           "#F2C500", 1.f, sweepTracks(yellowW, 54, 26), d);
        layers.push_back(yellow);
        const float yellow2W = yellowW;
        layers.push_back(rect("highlight_yellow_2", x - 4.f, y3 - 5.f, yellow2W, 39.f,
                              "#F2C500", 1.f, sweepTracks(yellow2W, 78, 25), d));
        addText("title", title, 315.f, 254.f, titleSize, kSerifBold);
    
        addText("paragraph_1", line1, x, y1, body, kSerif);
        addText("paragraph_2", line2, x, y2, body, kSerif);
        addText("paragraph_3", line3, x, y3, body, kSerif);
        Json plan = renderPlan("pill_press_reference_cpp_v2", d, layers, cameraSamples(d));
        plan["lighting_rig"] = {{"key_direction", Json::array({0.f, 0.f, 1.f})},
                                 {"key_intensity", 0.f}, {"key_color", Json::array({1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f})},
                                 {"ambient_intensity", 1.f}, {"ambient_color", Json::array({1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f})},
                                 {"rim_enabled", false}, {"rim_intensity", 0.f},
                                 {"rim_power", 1.f}, {"rim_color", Json::array({1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f})}};
        plan["camera"]["dof"] = {{"enabled", true}, {"focus_distance", 1158.06f},

        plan["camera"]["f_stop"] = 5.6f;
        plan["output"] = {{"path", "pill_press_reference_cpp_v2.mp4"}, {"format", "mp4"}, {"codec", "h264"}};
        return plan;
    }
    
    Json archivePlan() {
        constexpr int d = 180;
        Json layers = Json::array();
        auto desk = rect("desk", 0, 0, 1920, 1080, "#111315", 1.f, Json::array(), d);
        addNoiseVignette(desk, 0.018f, 8203, 0.52f);
        layers.push_back(desk);
        layers.push_back(rect("archive_paper", 95, 85, 1730, 910, "#F1EFE7", 1.f,
                              Json::array(), d));
    
        auto addLine = [&](const std::string& id, const std::string& text, float top) {
            constexpr float left = 230.f;
            constexpr float size = 31.f;
            constexpr const char* font = "assets/fonts/PlayfairDisplay.ttf";
            Json layer = textLayer(id, text, left, top, size, font, "#211F1C", d);
            const float run = measuredTextWidth(text, size, font);
            layer["position"][0] = left + run * 0.5f - 960.f;
            layer["position"][1] = 540.f - top - layer["size"][1].get<float>() * 0.5f;
            layers.push_back(std::move(layer));
        };
        addLine("mailchimp_1", "25. Records obtained from Mailchimp indicated that Mailchimp had an account under", 300.f);
        addLine("mailchimp_2", "the name \"NPRX,\" display name \"MR NPRX,\" associated with e-mail address", 354.f);
        addLine("mailchimp_3", "NeverPressedRX@secmail.pro, and that the account had been created on December 19, 2019.", 408.f);
        addLine("mailchimp_4", "The Mailchimp records also indicated that the NPRX account was created from IP address", 462.f);
        addLine("mailchimp_5", "73.134.88.148, assigned to Comcast. Records obtained from Comcast revealed that the", 516.f);
        addLine("mailchimp_6", "subscriber for that IP address was WILLIAM BURGAMY IV, with a service address of", 570.f);
    
        Json plan = renderPlan("archive_page_2_5d_dof_cpp_v1", d, layers, cameraSamples(d));
        plan["camera"]["position"] = Json::array({0.f, -20.f, -1158.06f});
        plan["camera"]["rotation_deg"] = Json::array({-10.f, -6.f, -1.4f});
        plan["camera"]["dof"] = {{"enabled", true}, {"focus_distance", 1158.06f},
                                  {"max_blur", 18.f}, {"highlight_gain", 0.18f}};
        plan["camera"]["f_stop"] = 2.5f;
        plan["lighting_rig"] = {{"key_direction", Json::array({0.f, 0.f, 1.f})},
                                 {"key_intensity", 0.f}, {"key_color", Json::array({1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f})},
                                 {"ambient_intensity", 1.f}, {"ambient_color", Json::array({1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f})},
                                 {"rim_enabled", false}, {"rim_intensity", 0.f},
                                 {"rim_power", 1.f}, {"rim_color", Json::array({1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f})}};
        plan["output"] = {{"path", "archive_page_2_5d_dof_cpp_v1.mp4"}, {"format", "mp4"}, {"codec", "h264"}};
        return plan;
    }
    }
    
    int main(int argc, char** argv) try {
        if (argc != 2) throw std::runtime_error("usage: chronontemplate_emit_user_reference_recreations <output-dir>");
        const fs::path out = fs::absolute(argv[1]);
        fs::create_directories(out);
        writePlan(out, "pill_press_reference_cpp_v2", pillPressPlan());
        writePlan(out, "archive_page_2_5d_dof_cpp_v1", archivePlan());
        std::cout << out.string() << '\n';
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << e.what() << '\n';
        return 1;
    }

    #include "chronontemplate/web/DocumentEvidencePack.hpp"
    
    #include <filesystem>
    #include <fstream>
    #include <iostream>
    #include <stdexcept>
    
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    using chronontemplate::web::DocumentEvidenceRecipe;
    using chronontemplate::web::DocumentEvidenceSpec;
    using chronontemplate::web::DocumentHighlight;
    
    namespace {
    void writePlan(const fs::path& out, const DocumentEvidenceSpec& spec) {
        const fs::path path = out / (spec.planName() + ".plan.json");
        std::ofstream file(path);
        if (!file) throw std::runtime_error("cannot write plan: " + path.string());
        file << chronontemplate::web::buildDocumentEvidencePlan(spec).dump(2) << '\n';
        std::cout << path.string() << '\n';
    }
    
    DocumentEvidenceSpec pillPress() {
        DocumentEvidenceSpec spec;
        spec.recipe = DocumentEvidenceRecipe::MarkerHighlight;
        spec.title = "Pill Press Threat";
        spec.body =
            "Drug traffickers use pill presses to press fentanyl into pills and punches and dies to imprint markings and logos onto those pills, producing pills that look like legitimate prescription medication — like oxycodone, Xanax, and Adderall — when those pills actually contain fentanyl, methamphetamine, and other deadly drugs.\n\n"
            "In 2023, the Drug Enforcement Administration seized over 79 million fake pills containing fentanyl — a more than 33% increase from the year before. DEA laboratory testing currently indicates that 7 out of 10 pills contain a potentially deadly dose of fentanyl.";
        const auto green = spec.body.find("Drug traffickers use pill presses to press fentanyl into pills");
        const auto yellow = spec.body.find("when those pills actually contain fentanyl, methamphetamine, and other deadly drugs.");
        if (green == std::string::npos || yellow == std::string::npos)
            throw std::logic_error("reference highlight phrase not found in body copy");
        spec.highlights.push_back({green, green + std::string("Drug traffickers use pill presses to press fentanyl into pills").size(),
                                   "#69BC43", 20, 24, .86f, true});
        spec.highlights.push_back({yellow, yellow + std::string("when those pills actually contain fentanyl, methamphetamine, and other deadly drugs.").size(),
                                   "#E7C132", 48, 30, .84f, true});
        spec.durationFrames = 180;
        spec.vignette = .78f;
        spec.grain = .018f;
        spec.depthOfField = false;
        spec.scanlines = true;
        return spec;
    }
    
    DocumentEvidenceSpec archiveMacro() {
        DocumentEvidenceSpec spec;
        spec.recipe = DocumentEvidenceRecipe::CinematicMacro;
        spec.body =
            "25. Records obtained from Mailchimp indicated that Mailchimp had an account under the name \"NPRX,\" display name \"MR NPRX,\" associated with e-mail address NeverPressedRX@secmail.pro, and that the account had been created on December 19, 2019.\n"
            "The Mailchimp records also indicated that the NPRX account was created from IP address 73.134.88.148, assigned to Comcast. Records obtained from Comcast revealed that the subscriber for that IP address was WILLIAM BURGAMY IV, with a service address of";
        spec.durationFrames = 180;
        spec.grain = .018f;
        spec.vignette = .72f;
        spec.cameraPush = .07f;
        spec.fovDegrees = 36.f;
        spec.tiltXDegrees = 10.f;
        spec.tiltYDegrees = 25.f;
        spec.rollDegrees = 10.f;
        spec.depthOfField = true;
        spec.scanlines = false;
        return spec;
    }
    }
    
    int main(int argc, char** argv) try {
        if (argc != 2) throw std::runtime_error("usage: chronontemplate_emit_user_reference_recreations <output-dir>");
        const fs::path out = fs::absolute(argv[1]);
        fs::create_directories(out);
        writePlan(out, pillPress());
        writePlan(out, archiveMacro());
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& e) {
        std::cerr << e.what() << '\n';
        return 1;
    }

    // ChrononMotion — animated cameras.
    //
    // A deterministic camera: the classic cinematographic moves (dolly, pan, tilt,
    // orbit, roll) as pure operations on a pose, plus the tracks that key them and a
    // look-at target that keeps the aim while the position moves.
    //
    // The camera is backed by a null Layer, so it can itself be parented under a
    // controller (a camera rig) and inherit that motion.
    
    #ifndef CHRONONMOTION_MOTION_CAMERARIG_HPP
    #define CHRONONMOTION_MOTION_CAMERARIG_HPP
    
    #include "chrononmotion/motion/Layer.hpp"
    #include "chrononmotion/motion/Track.hpp"
    
    #include "chrononmotion/cameras/PerspectiveCamera.hpp"
    #include "chrononmotion/math/Matrix4.hpp"
    #include "chrononmotion/math/Quaternion.hpp"
    #include "chrononmotion/math/Vector2.hpp"
    #include "chrononmotion/math/Vector3.hpp"
    
    #include <memory>
    
    namespace chrononmotion::motion {
    
        /// A sampled camera pose.
        struct CameraPose {
            Vector3 position{0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
            Quaternion orientation{0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 1.f};
    
            /// Point of interest. When set, the pose is aimed at it (the "look-at"
            /// channel), so dolly/pan/orbit keep the subject framed.
            Vector3 target{0.f, 0.f, 0.f};
            bool hasTarget{false};
    
            float fov{50.f};
    
            /// Focal length in millimetres. 0 means "not authored": `fov` wins.
            float focalLength{0.f};
            float sensorWidth{36.f}; ///< Sensor gate width in millimetres.
            float sensorHeight{24.f}; ///< Sensor gate height in millimetres.
            Vector2 lensShift{0.f, 0.f}; ///< Normalized output viewport shift; +X right, +Y down.
    
            /// Lens data for depth of field. Each 0 means "not authored": the motion
            /// side carries the numbers and never interprets them, so a renderer
            /// applies what is present and leaves the rest to its own optics. The
            /// units are the RenderPlan Chronon3D consumer contract: `fStop` (f/N)
            /// is the single authored aperture truth and feeds the physical model.
            float focusDistance{0.f}; ///< Distance to the focal plane along the view axis, world units.
            float maxBlur{0.f};        ///< Blur clamp in pixels of the target canvas; 0 means not authored.
            float fStop{0.f};         ///< Physical aperture as f/N (0.7..32); 0 means not authored.
            int irisBlades{0};        ///< Bokeh iris blades; 0 means circular.
            float highlightGain{0.f}; ///< Gain for bright out-of-focus highlights.
    
            /// Roll about the view axis, after the aim is solved.
            float roll{0.f};
        };
    
        /// First-order motion of a sampled camera pose, in channel units per
        /// second. The exact analytic derivative of the rig's own keys (the same
        /// math as `Track::velocity`): no finite-difference sampling error, no
        /// dependence on neighboring frames, which is what makes shutter motion
        /// blur computable per frame in isolation.
        struct CameraPoseDerivative {
            Vector3 linearVelocity{0.f, 0.f, 0.f};  ///< d(position)/dt, world space.
            Vector3 angularVelocity{0.f, 0.f, 0.f}; ///< ω = 2·q̇·q⁻¹, world space, rad/s.
            Vector3 targetVelocity{0.f, 0.f, 0.f};  ///< d(target)/dt, world space.
            float fovRate{0.f};                     ///< d(fov)/dt, degrees per second.
            float focusRate{0.f};                   ///< d(focusDistance)/dt, units per second.
            float rollRate{0.f};                    ///< d(roll)/dt, radians per second.
        };
    
        /// An animated perspective camera.
        class CameraRig {
        public:
            using Id = Layer::Id;
    
            explicit CameraRig(Id id = 1,
                               float fov = 50.f,
                               float aspect = 16.f / 9.f,
                               float nearPlane = 0.1f,
                               float farPlane = 2000.f);
    
            [[nodiscard]] Id id() const { return layer_.id; }
            [[nodiscard]] Layer& layer() { return layer_; }
            [[nodiscard]] const Layer& layer() const { return layer_; }
    
            // --- static pose (used wherever the matching track has no keys)
            CameraRig& setPosition(const Vector3& value);
            CameraRig& setOrientation(const Quaternion& value);
            CameraRig& setTarget(const Vector3& value);
            CameraRig& clearTarget();
            CameraRig& setFov(float degrees);
            CameraRig& setAspect(float widthOverHeight);
            CameraRig& setFocalLength(float millimetres);
            CameraRig& setSensorWidth(float millimetres);
            CameraRig& setSensorHeight(float millimetres);
            CameraRig& setLensShift(const Vector2& normalizedViewportShift);
            CameraRig& setRoll(float radians);
            CameraRig& setFocusDistance(float distance);
            CameraRig& setMaxBlur(float pixels);
            CameraRig& setFStop(float fStop);
            CameraRig& setIrisBlades(int blades);
            CameraRig& setHighlightGain(float gain);
            CameraRig& setParent(Layer::Id parentId);
    
            [[nodiscard]] Vector3 position() const { return layer_.transform.position; }
            [[nodiscard]] Quaternion orientation() const { return layer_.transform.orientation; }
            [[nodiscard]] bool hasTarget() const { return hasTarget_; }
            [[nodiscard]] Vector3 target() const { return target_; }
            [[nodiscard]] float fov() const { return fov_; }
            [[nodiscard]] float roll() const { return roll_; }
            [[nodiscard]] float focusDistance() const { return focusDistance_; }
            [[nodiscard]] float maxBlur() const { return maxBlur_; }
            [[nodiscard]] float fStop() const { return fStop_; }
            [[nodiscard]] int irisBlades() const { return irisBlades_; }
            [[nodiscard]] float highlightGain() const { return highlightGain_; }
            [[nodiscard]] float aspect() const { return aspect_; }
            [[nodiscard]] float nearPlane() const { return nearPlane_; }
            [[nodiscard]] float farPlane() const { return farPlane_; }
    
            /// A camera node configured with this rig's projection, ready for `apply`.
            [[nodiscard]] std::shared_ptr<PerspectiveCamera> makeCamera() const;
    
            // --- animation channels
            [[nodiscard]] Track<Vector3>& positionTrack() { return layer_.tracks.position; }
            [[nodiscard]] Track<Quaternion>& orientationTrack() { return layer_.tracks.orientation; }
            [[nodiscard]] Track<float>& opacityTrack() { return layer_.tracks.opacity; }
            [[nodiscard]] Track<Vector3>& targetTrack() { return targetTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] Track<float>& fovTrack() { return fovTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] Track<float>& focalLengthTrack() { return focalTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] const Track<float>& focalLengthTrack() const { return focalTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] Track<float>& rollTrack() { return rollTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] Track<float>& focusDistanceTrack() { return focusDistanceTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] const Track<float>& focusDistanceTrack() const { return focusDistanceTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] Track<float>& maxBlurTrack() { return maxBlurTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] const Track<float>& maxBlurTrack() const { return maxBlurTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] Track<float>& fStopTrack() { return fStopTrack_; }
            [[nodiscard]] const Track<float>& fStopTrack() const { return fStopTrack_; }
    
            /// Sample the local pose at `seconds`.
            [[nodiscard]] CameraPose sample(float seconds) const;
    
            /// Resolve an already sampled local camera pose into world space under
            /// `parentWorld`. Its orientation must already include look-at and roll.
            /// Rejects non-finite, singular, sheared, or reflected parent transforms.
            [[nodiscard]] static CameraPose resolveWorldPose(CameraPose pose, const Matrix4& parentWorld);
    
            /// Sample the pose at `seconds` and resolve it under `parentWorld`.
            [[nodiscard]] CameraPose sampleWorld(float seconds, const Matrix4& parentWorld) const;
    
            /// The analytic derivative of the pose at `seconds`. Reports zero for
            /// every channel without keys at the requested time (outside the keyed
            /// range a track holds its value, so its rate is zero). The angular
            /// velocity is the world-space ω a shutter/blur integrator consumes:
            /// with a target authored, that is the re-aim rotation ω = f × ḟ of the
            /// view axis itself (the look-at overrides the orientation channel and
            /// a dolly toward a fixed target still swings the camera), plus the
            /// roll rate about the backward view axis; without a target, it is the
            /// orientation channel's ω = 2·q̇·q⁻¹ plus the same roll term.
            [[nodiscard]] CameraPoseDerivative sampleDerivative(float seconds) const;
    
            /// Sample and write into a camera node, optionally under a parent world
            /// matrix (the rig's own parented motion).
            void apply(float seconds, PerspectiveCamera& camera, const Matrix4* parentWorld = nullptr) const;
            void apply(const CameraPose& pose, PerspectiveCamera& camera, const Matrix4* parentWorld = nullptr) const;
    
            /// Latest key on any channel of the rig, in seconds.
            [[nodiscard]] float endTime() const;
    
            // --- the pure moves. Each is a function of the pose it is given, so it
            // can be applied at any time and then keyed.
            static void lookAtPose(CameraPose& pose, const Vector3& target);
    
            /// Move along the view axis: positive is forward, toward the target.
            static void dolly(CameraPose& pose, float distance);
    
            /// Translate in the camera's own plane (right = +x, up = +y).
            static void pan(CameraPose& pose, const Vector2& delta);
    
            /// Pitch about the camera's local X axis.
            static void tilt(CameraPose& pose, float radians);
    
            /// Yaw about world Y, then pitch about the camera's right axis.
            static void orbit(CameraPose& pose, float yaw, float pitch);
    
            /// Orbit the position around an explicit pivot and re-aim at it.

    using Json = nlohmann::json;
    using Point = native::Paths::Point;
    constexpr int kW = 1920, kH = 1080, kFps = 30;
    constexpr const char* kInter = "ChrononTemplate/assets/fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf";
    constexpr const char* kInterBold = "ChrononTemplate/assets/fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf";
    constexpr const char* kSerif = "ChrononTemplate/assets/fonts/PlayfairDisplay.ttf";
    
    struct BodyLine { std::string text; std::size_t begin{}, end{}; float y{}; };
    
    Json color(const std::string& hex, float alpha = 1.f) {
        if (hex.size() != 7 || hex.front() != '#') throw std::invalid_argument("color must be #RRGGBB");
        const auto v = std::stoul(hex.substr(1), nullptr, 16);
        return Json::array({((v >> 16) & 255) / 255.0, ((v >> 8) & 255) / 255.0,
                            (v & 255) / 255.0, alpha});
    }
    
    Json rect(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h,
              const std::string& fill, float alpha, int frames, bool screen = false) {
        Json layer{{"id", id}, {"type", "shape"}, {"enable_3d", !screen},
                   {"size", {w, h}}, {"position", {x + w * .5f, float(kH) - (y + h * .5f), 0.f}},
                   {"start_frame", 0}, {"duration_frames", frames},
                   {"shape", {{"type", "rect"}, {"fill", color(fill, alpha)}}}};
        if (screen) { layer["screen_space"] = true; layer["position"] = {0.f, 0.f}; }
        return layer;
    }
    
    Json textLayer(const std::string& id, const std::string& text, float x, float y,
                   float size, const char* font, const std::string& fill, int frames) {
        Json layer = chronontemplate::web::shot::textLayer(id, text, x, y, size, font, fill, frames);
        const float run = shot::measuredTextWidth(text, size, font);
        layer["position"][0] = x + run * .5f - 960.f;
        layer["position"][1] = 540.f - y - layer["size"][1].get<float>() * .5f;
        return layer;
    }
    
    float measure(const std::string& text, float size, const char* font) {
        return std::max(0.f, shot::measuredTextWidth(text, size, font));
    }
    
    std::vector<BodyLine> wrapBody(const std::string& body, float size, const char* font,
                                   float maxWidth, float firstY) {
        std::vector<BodyLine> lines;
        std::size_t para = 0;
        float y = firstY;
        while (para <= body.size()) {
            const std::size_t nl = body.find('\n', para);
            const std::size_t paraEnd = nl == std::string::npos ? body.size() : nl;
            std::size_t start = para;
            while (start < paraEnd) {
                while (start < paraEnd && body[start] == ' ') ++start;
                std::size_t end = start;
                std::size_t lastFit = start;
                while (end < paraEnd) {
                    const std::size_t space = body.find(' ', end);
                    const std::size_t wordEnd = std::min(space == std::string::npos ? paraEnd : space, paraEnd);
                    const std::string candidate = body.substr(start, wordEnd - start);
                    if (measure(candidate, size, font) > maxWidth && lastFit > start) break;
                    if (measure(candidate, size, font) > maxWidth) { lastFit = wordEnd; break; }
                    lastFit = wordEnd;
                    end = wordEnd;
                    if (end >= paraEnd) break;
                    end = body.find_first_not_of(' ', end);
                    if (end == std::string::npos || end >= paraEnd) break;
                }
                if (lastFit <= start) lastFit = paraEnd;
                const std::size_t visibleEnd = lastFit;
                if (visibleEnd > start) {
                    lines.push_back({body.substr(start, visibleEnd - start), start, visibleEnd, y});
                y += size * 1.62f;
                }
                start = visibleEnd;
                while (start < paraEnd && body[start] == ' ') ++start;
            }
            if (nl == std::string::npos) break;
            para = nl + 1;
            if (para < body.size() && body[para] == '\n') { y += size * .78f; ++para; }
        }
        return lines;
    }
    
    Json roughMarker(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height,
                     const std::string& hex, float opacity, bool rough,
                     int start, int reveal, int frames, unsigned seed) {
        native::HighlightStyle style = native::highlightingStyle(rough ? "marker_rough" : "marker_soft");
        style.color = hex;
        style.opacity = opacity;
        style.width = height;
        Json layer = shot::rect(id, x, y - height * .5f, width, height, style.color,
                                style.opacity, shot::sweepTracks(width, start, reveal), frames);
        if (style.rough) layer["effects"] = Json::array({
            Json{{"type", "roughen_edges"}, {"amount", 2.2f}, {"scale", 10.f},
                 {"complexity", 2}, {"seed", seed}}});
        layer["blend_mode"] = "multiply";
        return layer;
    }
    
    Json effectStack(const DocumentEvidenceSpec& spec, unsigned seed) {
        Json effects = Json::array({
            Json{{"type", "noise"}, {"amount", spec.grain}, {"seed", seed}, {"size", 1.f}, {"animated", false}},
            Json{{"type", "chromatic_aberration"}, {"red_offset", .8f}, {"blue_offset", -.8f}},
            Json{{"type", "vignette"}, {"amount", spec.vignette}, {"radius", .58f}, {"softness", .72f}}});
        if (spec.scanlines) effects.push_back(Json{{"type", "scanlines"}, {"spacing_px", 2.5f},
                                                   {"amount", .025f}, {"phase", 0.f}});
        return effects;
    }
    
    Json cameraPlan(const DocumentEvidenceSpec& spec, bool macro) {
        const float cameraZ = macro ? 1700.f : 1158.06f;
        chrononmotion::motion::CameraRig rig(1, spec.fovDegrees, float(kW) / kH, 1.f, 10000.f);
        constexpr float degToRad = 0.01745329251994329577f;
        const float yaw = macro ? spec.tiltYDegrees * degToRad : 0.f;
        const float pitch = macro ? spec.tiltXDegrees * degToRad : 0.f;
        rig.setPosition({cameraZ * std::sin(yaw) * std::cos(pitch),
                         cameraZ * std::sin(pitch),
                         cameraZ * std::cos(yaw) * std::cos(pitch)});
        rig.setTarget({0.f, 0.f, 0.f});
        if (macro) rig.setRoll(spec.rollDegrees * degToRad);
        const float push = std::clamp(spec.cameraPush, 0.f, .2f) * cameraZ;
        if (push > 0.f) chrononmotion::motion::presets::cameraPush(rig, 0, spec.durationFrames - 1,
                                                                   push, float(spec.fps));
        Json samples = native::Camera::samples(rig, float(spec.fps), spec.durationFrames);
        const float focus = cameraZ - (macro ? push * .5f : 0.f);
        for (Json& sample : samples) {
            sample["camera"]["dof"] = {{"enabled", spec.depthOfField}, {"focus_distance", focus},
                                         {"max_blur", 18.f}, {"highlight_gain", .2f}};
            if (spec.depthOfField) sample["camera"]["f_stop"] = 2.5f;
        }
        return Json{{"camera", samples.front().at("camera")}, {"camera_samples", std::move(samples)}};
    }
    
    } // namespace
    
    void DocumentEvidenceSpec::validate() const {
        if (fps != kFps) throw std::invalid_argument("DocumentEvidencePack fps must be 30");
        if (durationFrames < 30 || durationFrames > 300) throw std::invalid_argument("durationFrames must be in [30,300]");
        if (title.empty() && body.empty() && sourceImage.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("document content is empty");
        if (grain < 0.f || grain > .1f || vignette < 0.f || vignette > 1.f || cameraPush < 0.f || cameraPush > .2f)
            throw std::invalid_argument("document optical settings are out of range");
        for (const auto& h : highlights) {
            if (h.byteStart >= h.byteEnd || h.byteEnd > body.size() || h.startFrame < 0 ||
                h.revealFrames < 1 || h.startFrame + h.revealFrames >= durationFrames ||
                h.opacity < 0.f || h.opacity > 1.f)
                throw std::invalid_argument("document highlight range or timing is invalid");
        }
    }
    
    std::string DocumentEvidenceSpec::planName() const {
        return recipe == DocumentEvidenceRecipe::CinematicMacro
            ? "document_evidence_cinematic_macro_v1" : "document_evidence_marker_highlight_v1";
    }
    
    nlohmann::json buildDocumentEvidencePlan(const DocumentEvidenceSpec& spec) {
        spec.validate();
        const bool macro = spec.recipe == DocumentEvidenceRecipe::CinematicMacro;
        const float textSize = macro ? 31.f : 29.f;
        const char* bodyFont = macro ? kSerif : kInter;
        const float left = macro ? 230.f : 260.f;
        const float maxWidth = macro ? 1420.f : 1400.f;
        const float bodyY = spec.title.empty() ? 325.f : 392.f;
        const float pageX = macro ? 90.f : 0.f;
        const float pageY = macro ? 70.f : 0.f;
        const float pageW = macro ? 1740.f : float(kW);
        const float pageH = macro ? 940.f : float(kH);
        Json layers = Json::array();
    
        Json desk = rect("document_desk", 0.f, 0.f, float(kW), float(kH), "#111315", 1.f,
                         spec.durationFrames, true);
        desk["effects"] = effectStack(spec, 731);
        layers.push_back(std::move(desk));
        Json paper = rect("document_paper", pageX, pageY, pageW, pageH,
                          macro ? "#E9E8E6" : "#E6E3E1", 1.f, spec.durationFrames, !macro);
        paper["effects"] = Json::array({Json{{"type", "noise"}, {"amount", spec.grain},
                                             {"seed", 2203}, {"size", 1.f}, {"animated", false}}});
        if (!macro) paper["effects"].push_back(Json{{"type", "vignette"}, {"amount", spec.vignette},
                                                    {"radius", .58f}, {"softness", .72f}});
        layers.push_back(std::move(paper));
    
        if (!spec.sourceImage.empty()) {
            layers.push_back(shot::image("document_source", spec.sourceImage, pageX, pageY, pageW, pageH,
                                         spec.durationFrames));
        }
    
        const auto lines = wrapBody(spec.body, textSize, bodyFont, maxWidth, bodyY);
        if (!macro) {
            for (const DocumentHighlight& h : spec.highlights) {
                for (std::size_t n = 0; n < lines.size(); ++n) {
                    const BodyLine& line = lines[n];
                    const std::size_t begin = std::max(h.byteStart, line.begin);
                    const std::size_t end = std::min(h.byteEnd, line.end);
                    if (begin >= end) continue;
                    const float prefix = measure(line.text.substr(0, begin - line.begin), textSize, bodyFont);
                    const float width = measure(line.text.substr(begin - line.begin, end - begin), textSize, bodyFont);
                    layers.push_back(roughMarker("marker_" + std::to_string(n) + "_" + std::to_string(h.startFrame),
                        left + prefix, line.y + textSize * .65f, width + 5.f, textSize * 1.06f,
                        h.color, h.opacity, h.rough, h.startFrame + static_cast<int>(n) * 8,
                        h.revealFrames, spec.durationFrames, 731U + static_cast<unsigned>(n)));
                }
            }
        }
    
        if (!spec.title.empty()) {
            Json title = textLayer("document_title", spec.title, left, 320.f, 40.f, kInterBold,
                                   "#353535", spec.durationFrames);
            if (macro) title["effects"] = Json::array({Json{{"type", "gaussian_blur"}, {"radius", 1.4f}}});
            layers.push_back(std::move(title));
        }
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < lines.size(); ++i)
            layers.push_back(textLayer("document_body_" + std::to_string(i), lines[i].text,
                                       left, lines[i].y, textSize, bodyFont, "#353535", spec.durationFrames));
    
        Json camera = macro
            ? cameraPlan(spec, true)
            : Json{{"camera", shot::staticCamera()}, {"camera_samples", nullptr}};
        Json plan = native::TemplateComposition::renderPlan(spec.planName(), kW, kH, spec.fps,
            spec.durationFrames, layers, camera["camera"], camera["camera_samples"],
            {{"path", spec.planName() + ".mp4"}, {"format", "mp4"}, {"codec", "h264"}});
        plan["lighting_rig"] = {{"key_direction", {0.f, 0.f, 1.f}}, {"key_intensity", 0.f},
                                {"key_color", {1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f}}, {"ambient_intensity", 1.f},
                                {"ambient_color", {1.f, 1.f, 1.f, 1.f}}, {"rim_enabled", false}};
        return plan;
    }

    void writePlan(const fs::path& out, const DocumentEvidenceSpec& spec) {
        const fs::path path = out / (spec.planName() + ".plan.json");
        std::ofstream file(path);
        if (!file) throw std::runtime_error("cannot write plan: " + path.string());
        file << chronontemplate::web::buildDocumentEvidencePlan(spec).dump(2) << '\n';
        std::cout << path.string() << '\n';
    }
    
    DocumentEvidenceSpec pillPress() {
        DocumentEvidenceSpec spec;
        spec.recipe = DocumentEvidenceRecipe::MarkerHighlight;
        spec.title = "Pill Press Threat";
        spec.body =
            "Drug traffickers use pill presses to press fentanyl into pills and punches and dies to imprint markings and logos onto those pills, producing pills that look like legitimate prescription medication — like oxycodone, Xanax, and Adderall — when those pills actually contain fentanyl, methamphetamine, and other deadly drugs.\n\n"
            "In 2023, the Drug Enforcement Administration seized over 79 million fake pills containing fentanyl — a more than 33% increase from the year before. DEA laboratory testing currently indicates that 7 out of 10 pills contain a potentially deadly dose of fentanyl.";
        const auto green = spec.body.find("Drug traffickers use pill presses to press fentanyl into pills");
        const auto yellow = spec.body.find("when those pills actually contain fentanyl, methamphetamine, and other deadly drugs.");
        if (green == std::string::npos || yellow == std::string::npos)
            throw std::logic_error("reference highlight phrase not found in body copy");
        spec.highlights.push_back({green, green + std::string("Drug traffickers use pill presses to press fentanyl into pills").size(),
                                   "#69BC43", 20, 24, .86f, true});
        spec.highlights.push_back({yellow, yellow + std::string("when those pills actually contain fentanyl, methamphetamine, and other deadly drugs.").size(),
                                   "#E7C132", 48, 30, .84f, true});
        spec.durationFrames = 180;
        spec.vignette = .78f;
        spec.grain = .018f;
        spec.fovDegrees = 50.f;
        spec.cameraPush = 0.f;
        spec.depthOfField = false;
        spec.scanlines = true;
        return spec;
    }

    /// Distanza camera che mappa 1 unita' = 1 px: il piano a z=0 riempie il canvas.
    /// Con fov verticale 50deg: (1080/2) / tan(25deg) = 1158.06.
    inline constexpr float kCameraBaseDistance = 1158.06f;
    
    /// Static camera: 1 unita' = 1 px. Con fov verticale 50deg la distanza che
    /// mappa 1080 unita' su 1080px e' 540/tan(25deg) = 1158.06 = kCameraBaseDistance
    /// (verificato con render di calibrazione: rettangoli a x 200/900/1600 tornano
    /// al px con -1158.06; la vecchia -1320 con yaw 0.5deg scalava tutto di 0.877
    /// verso il centro e traslava i bordi).
    inline Json staticCamera() {
        return Json{{"type", "perspective"},
                    {"position", Json::array({0.f, 0.f, -kCameraBaseDistance})},
                    {"rotation_deg", Json::array({0.f, 0.f, 0.f})},
                    {"fov_deg", 50.f}, {"near", 1.f}, {"far", 10000.f}, {"zoom", 1.f},
                    {"sensor_width_mm", 36.f}, {"lens_shift", Json::array({0.f, 0.f})}};
    }
    
    /// Camera samples per-frame: asse centrale e push molto leggero, senza yaw,
    /// roll, tilt o oscillazioni. Il push e' uno zoom ottico minimo, quindi non
    /// sposta gli elementi rispetto al centro del frame.
    inline Json cameraSamples(int duration) {
        Json samples = Json::array();
        for (int frame = 0; frame < duration; ++frame) {
            const float progress = duration > 1 ? float(frame) / float(duration - 1) : 1.f;
            const float zoom = 1.f + 0.035f * progress;
            Json camera = {
                {"type", "perspective"},
                {"position", Json::array({0.f, 0.f, -kCameraBaseDistance})},
                {"rotation_deg", Json::array({0.f, 0.f, 0.f})},
                {"fov_deg", 50.f}, {"near", 100.f}, {"far", 10000.f}, {"zoom", zoom},
                {"sensor_width_mm", 36.f},
                {"lens_shift", Json::array({0.f, 0.f})},
                {"dof", Json{{"enabled", false}, {"focus_distance", kCameraBaseDistance},
                             {"aperture", 0.f}, {"max_blur", 0.f}}}};
            samples.push_back(Json{{"frame", frame}, {"camera", std::move(camera)}});
        }
        return samples;
    }
    
    /// Port of Shot.camera()/apply_camera() camera inputs. The Python authoring
    /// data is a linear (zoom, center-x, center-y) move; keep the camera axis
    /// aligned to the pixel-authored layer plane instead of applying a shared
    /// dolly and yaw to every shot.
    inline Json cameraSamples(int duration, double zoomFrom, double cxFrom, double cyFrom,
                              double zoomTo, double cxTo, double cyTo) {
        Json samples = Json::array();
        for (int frame = 0; frame < duration; ++frame) {
            const double t = duration > 1 ? double(frame) / double(duration - 1) : 1.0;
            const double zoom = zoomFrom + (zoomTo - zoomFrom) * t;
            const double cx = cxFrom + (cxTo - cxFrom) * t;
            const double cy = cyFrom + (cyTo - cyFrom) * t;
            Json camera = {
                {"type", "perspective"},
                {"position", Json::array({(cx - 0.5) * kW, (0.5 - cy) * kH,
                                          -kCameraBaseDistance})},
                {"rotation_deg", Json::array({0.f, 0.f, 0.f})},
                {"fov_deg", 50.f}, {"near", 100.f}, {"far", 10000.f}, {"zoom", zoom},
                {"sensor_width_mm", 36.f}, {"lens_shift", Json::array({0.f, 0.f})},
                {"dof", Json{{"enabled", false}, {"focus_distance", kCameraBaseDistance},
                             {"aperture", 0.f}, {"max_blur", 0.f}}}};
            samples.push_back(Json{{"frame", frame}, {"camera", std::move(camera)}});
        }
        return samples;
    }
    
    namespace modules {
    struct DocumentCamera {
        static Json samples(int duration, double zoomFrom, double cxFrom, double cyFrom,
                            double zoomTo, double cxTo, double cyTo) {
            return cameraSamples(duration,zoomFrom,cxFrom,cyFrom,zoomTo,cxTo,cyTo);
        }
    };

    // Emit the first ChrononTemplate web archive still as a native RenderPlan V3.
    #include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
    
    #include <filesystem>
    #include <fstream>
    #include <iostream>
    #include <stdexcept>
    #include <string>
    
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    using Json = nlohmann::json;
    
    namespace {
    constexpr int kWidth = 1920;
    constexpr int kHeight = 1080;
    constexpr int kFrames = 1;
    
    Json rgba(const std::string& color, double alpha = 1.0) {
        const auto rgb = std::stoul(color.substr(1), nullptr, 16);
        return {((rgb >> 16) & 255) / 255.0, ((rgb >> 8) & 255) / 255.0,
                (rgb & 255) / 255.0, alpha};
    }
    
    Json rect(const std::string& id, double x, double y, double width, double height,
              const std::string& color, double alpha = 1.0) {
        return {{"id", id}, {"type", "shape"}, {"enable_3d", true},
                {"position", {x + width * .5, kHeight - (y + height * .5), 0.0}},
                {"size", {width, height}}, {"start_frame", 0},
                {"duration_frames", kFrames},
                {"shape", {{"type", "rect"}, {"fill", rgba(color, alpha)}}}};
    }
    
    Json text(const std::string& id, const std::string& value, double x, double y,
              double width, double height, double fontSize, const std::string& font,
              const std::string& color, const std::string& align = "left") {
        return {{"id", id}, {"type", "text"}, {"enable_3d", true}, {"text", value},
                {"position", {x + width * .5, kHeight - (y + height * .5), 0.0}},
                {"size", {width, height}}, {"start_frame", 0},
                {"duration_frames", kFrames},
                {"style", {{"font", font}, {"font_size", fontSize},
                            {"fill", color}, {"fit_mode", "none"},
                            {"text_align", align}}}};
    }
    
    Json image(const std::string& id, const std::string& asset, double x, double y,
               double width, double height) {
        return {{"id", id}, {"type", "image"}, {"enable_3d", true}, {"screen_space", true},
                {"asset", asset}, {"position", {x + width * .5, y + height * .5, 0.0}},
                {"size", {width, height}}, {"fit", "cover"},
                {"start_frame", 0}, {"duration_frames", kFrames}};
    }
    
    Json makePlan() {
        Json layers = Json::array();
        layers.push_back({{"id", "archive_canvas"}, {"type", "color"},
                          {"color", rgba("#E5E2DC")}, {"size", {kWidth, kHeight}},
                          {"screen_space", true}, {"start_frame", 0},
                          {"duration_frames", kFrames}});
        layers.push_back(rect("paper_shadow", 100, 68, 1720, 960, "#D3CFC8"));
        layers.push_back(rect("archive_paper", 100, 60, 1720, 960, "#EBE9E4"));
    
        layers.push_back(text("archive_label", "ARCHIVE IMAGE", 178, 119, 250, 26,
                              12, "assets/fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf", "#5B5751"));
        layers.push_back(rect("archive_label_rule", 178, 148, 122, 1, "#8B857C"));
        layers.push_back(text("archive_subject", "Bednyaks, Serednyaks, and Kulaks",
                              178, 156, 470, 24, 13, "assets/fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf", "#625D56"));
    
        // Full phrase receives one continuous marker underline, rendered behind the text.
        layers.push_back(rect("headline_marker_underline", 426, 281, 954, 13, "#D5B54B"));
        layers.push_back(text("archive_headline", "The stories behind the frames we keep",
                              178, 226, 1450, 80, 54,
                              "assets/fonts/PlayfairDisplay-Bold.ttf", "#282722"));
        layers.push_back(rect("headline_divider", 178, 328, 1564, 1, "#C8C3BA"));
    
        constexpr double x1 = 248, x2 = 737, x3 = 1225;
        constexpr double cardWidth = 447, cardHeight = 326, cardTop = 392;
        layers.push_back(rect("photo_shadow_1", x1, cardTop + 12, cardWidth, cardHeight, "#D4D0C8"));
        layers.push_back(rect("photo_shadow_2", x2, cardTop + 12, cardWidth, cardHeight, "#D4D0C8"));
        layers.push_back(rect("photo_shadow_3", x3, cardTop + 12, cardWidth, cardHeight, "#D4D0C8"));
        layers.push_back(image("archive_bednyaks", "assets/web_archive_v1/bednyaks.png",
                               x1, cardTop, cardWidth, cardHeight));
        layers.push_back(image("archive_serednyaks", "assets/web_archive_v1/serednyaks.png",
                               x2, cardTop, cardWidth, cardHeight));
        layers.push_back(image("archive_kulaks", "assets/web_archive_v1/kulaks.png",
                               x3, cardTop, cardWidth, cardHeight));
        layers.push_back(text("photo_label_01", "Bednyaks", x1, 725, cardWidth, 35, 22,
                              "assets/fonts/PlayfairDisplay.ttf", "#454039", "center"));
        layers.push_back(text("photo_label_02", "Serednyaks", x2, 725, cardWidth, 35, 22,
                              "assets/fonts/PlayfairDisplay.ttf", "#454039", "center"));
        layers.push_back(text("photo_label_03", "Kulaks", x3, 725, cardWidth, 35, 22,
                              "assets/fonts/PlayfairDisplay.ttf", "#454039", "center"));
        layers.push_back(rect("archive_footer_rule", 178, 958, 1564, 1, "#C7C1B7"));
        layers.push_back(text("archive_footer_left", "CHRONON ARCHIVE  ·  FIELD NOTES",
                              178, 974, 650, 18, 10, "assets/fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf", "#777168"));
        layers.push_back(text("archive_footer_right", "COLLECTION 01  /  PHOTOGRAPHIC RECORD",
                              1120, 974, 622, 18, 10, "assets/fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf", "#777168", "right"));
    
        return {{"schema", "chronon.render-plan.v3"}, {"version", 3},
                {"job_id", "web_archive_triptych_native_v1"},
                {"canvas", {{"width", kWidth}, {"height", kHeight},
                            {"fps_num", 30}, {"fps_den", 1}, {"duration_frames", kFrames}}},
                {"camera", {{"type", "perspective"}, {"position", {0, 0, -1158}},
                            {"rotation_deg", {0, 0, 0}}, {"fov_deg", 50},
                            {"near", 1}, {"far", 5000}}},
                {"layers", std::move(layers)},
                {"output", {{"path", "web_archive_triptych.mp4"}, {"format", "mp4"},
                            {"codec", "h264"}}}};
    }
    } // namespace
    
    int main(int argc, char** argv) try {
        if (argc != 2) throw std::runtime_error("usage: chronontemplate_emit_web_archive_triptych <plan.json>");
        const fs::path output = fs::absolute(argv[1]);
        fs::create_directories(output.parent_path());
        std::ofstream file(output);
        file << makePlan().dump(2) << '\n';
        if (!file) throw std::runtime_error("failed to write plan: " + output.string());
        std::cout << output << '\n';
        return 0;
    } catch (const std::exception& error) {
        std::cerr << error.what() << '\n';
        return 1;
    }

     const fs::path out=fs::absolute(argv[1]);
     // Motion and composition use pixel units, origin at upper-left, +Y down, camera forward +Z.
     // The selected line stays in the same viewport band while the actual perspective camera tracks down the list.
     constexpr float cx=W*.5f, cz=1200.f;
     const float rows[]={240.f,440.f,640.f,840.f};
     const float depths[]={0.f,0.f,0.f,0.f};
     CameraRig rig(1,55.f,static_cast<float>(W)/H,1.f,5000.f);
     rig.setPosition({cx,rows[0],cz}).setTarget({cx,rows[0],0.f}).setFov(55.f);
     const Easing glide=Easing::easeInOut();
     rig.positionTrack().add(0.f,{cx,rows[0],cz-depths[0]},glide);
     rig.targetTrack().add(0.f,{cx,rows[0],depths[0]},glide);
     for(int i=1;i<4;++i){
       const float moveStart=static_cast<float>(i*BEAT-MOVE_START_OFFSET)/FPS;
       const float arrive=static_cast<float>(i*BEAT+MOVE_ARRIVE_OFFSET)/FPS;
       rig.positionTrack().add(moveStart,{cx,rows[i-1],cz-depths[i-1]},glide).add(arrive,{cx,rows[i],cz-depths[i]},glide);

     }
